newsitem.title: MEXICO: World sugar markets further dominated by specs.
newsitem.headline: World sugar markets further dominated by specs.

text.p: World sugar markets are increasingly being dominated by speculators with open interest in the New York futures market probably now around 70 percent from speculator interests, a leading sugar trader said here Wednesday.

Peter Hulme, formerly director of trading with Tate & Lyle and now with Sucden, told the F.O. Licht World Sugar and Sweetners' Conference here that open interest from specs in New York futures had grown from 25 percent in 1974 to 50 percent in 1980 and 60 percent in 1990.

"It is probably now close to 70 percent. They have infinite amounts of money to throw at the market," Hulme said, adding that the percentage was such that it meant speculators could counteract efforts by sugar trade or producers to influence price.
